records.algorithm_name: P2 结构语义自适应求解

timing.evaluation_precision: outer monotonic process wall seconds, sampled to Python perf_counter precision
timing.utc: start/end ISO UTC Z; wall durations use monotonic clock

solver.method: deterministic graph-family routing among resource-word, tree, component-DAG, vector-arrival and structural repair constructors; one published candidate per coordinate with zero online E0/E1/E2 calls

measurement.solver_scope: outer subprocess launch through plan publication and process exit; graph read and structural validation included
measurement.evaluation_scope: independent frozen official P2 CLI launch through result/trace/log publication and exit; excludes offline gzip
measurement.offline_costs: uv sync --locked and frozen case extraction before batch T0; no training, case-specific precompute, or compilation

missing_reasons.provenance.environment.threads: per-process thread count was not sampled; BLAS/OMP/MKL configured to 1
missing_reasons.provenance.measurement.seed: deterministic structural constructor has no RNG seed

notes: P2 adaptive-semantic unified source: 100 original cases x 1-5 cores, 500 coordinates. Old 6e5099 version's incomplete batch is not mixed here.
Successful cells received an independent frozen official P2 E0 final check; timeout/not_run cells have no verified makespan.
Runner source bytes matched fixed commit after initial preflight; all runs used the same byte hash.
Peak RSS is sampled per child process group; not a hard whole-batch memory cap.
